description.default: A standalone EPUB/PDF reader for SiYuan: shelf and progress, immersive typography, highlights and offline dictionaries, bilingual reading, TTS, and an AI reading assistant that cites passages and saves answers as notes — all stored locally.
description.zh-CN: 思源里的独立 EPUB/PDF 阅读器：书架与进度、沉浸排版、六色高亮与离线词典、腾讯机翻双语对照、四引擎朗读，还有一个能按页/章提问、引用回跳、存成思源笔记的 AI 阅读助手。批注、进度与设置全部本地存储。
